split: 60% fit / 20% calibration / 20% validation in temporal order
noise: uniform integer bytes in [56,72], omitted from predictor
shift: append 200 bytes instead of training distribution
ood: query sizes -1 and 10000000; never execute those queries
limitations: Real OS file effects in controlled temporary workload; not a real-user longitudinal benchmark or a universal world model. No tuning on forward outcomes.
